controls.reserve_note: The recorded seven-day development corpus does not contain the 250-day primary minimum or the 500-day sensitivity window; this run is development-only.

notional_rule: notional = capital * risk_fraction (not a hard-coded 100 USDT)
report_hash_rule: JCS over the report with integers outside the JCS safe range represented as decimal strings
scope_note: Seven-day BTC development week only. The 26-month mark calendar and fresh OOS are separate, narrower scopes and are not accessed here.

train.selection_rule: max train-only net PnL over the frozen 12-variant family; ties by strategy_id

venue.note: The 20 USDT target is below the 0.001 BTC venue minimum at this price; it cannot be honored without rounding up and changing the risk target.
